caption: The drawing depicts a quilt design composed of several square sections arranged in a grid. The left side features repeating starburst or sunburst patterns rendered in shades of red and pink with small floral motifs, each radiating from a circular center. Adjacent squares contain leaf and vine motifs with crosshatch patterns inside each leaf; these are outlined in gray on a light cream or off-white background. The right side of the composition shows a diagonal, winding pink and black stem with three branches. Along these branches are flower shapes in muted red, blue, and green; the blue and green sections have smaller, subtle dot patterns, and the pink flowers have a similar motif to the starbursts. The background of the entire design is cream-colored with regularly spaced diagonal gray lines that create a quilted texture. A vertical deep blue border with small lighter floral prints runs along the far right edge. At the bottom, the text "JACOB SHELER'S 1937" is faintly visible.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
